title: Red Hat Security Advisory: pki-core:10.6 security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-76561) exists in the pki-core component of Red Hat Certificate System, specifically in the certprofile-import functionality. This flaw allows code execution due to unsanitized profile content involving the ExternalProcessConstraint. Red Hat has issued an important security update addressing this issue for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.4 variants. The vulnerability is rated with high severity, but no CVSS score is provided in the available data.
